channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Tabata Amaral distribui santinhos sem Lula, Alckmin, Tebet e Haddad
item.description: Federal representative Tabata Amaral, president of the PSB in São Paulo and candidate for re-election, distributed campaign leaflets that omitted images and names of other candidates such as Lula, Haddad, Alckmin, and Tebet, according to a report from January 10, 2026. This strategy may reflect an effort to maintain neutrality or avoid explicit alliances with figures from other parties. The PSB has sought to position itself as a progressive alternative without relying on traditional coalitions.

item.title: ‘Nepobaby vingativo e esquerdista decrépito’: o que jornais lá fora falam sobre eleição no Brasil
item.description: International media coverage of the Brazilian election is marked by skepticism, describing the race as an 'unpopularity contest' between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro. The Economist and The Guardian highlight risks to democracy, economy, and the environment, especially with potential external influences like Trump.

item.title: Dólar vai a R$ 5,22 em dia de estresse nos juros globais. Bolsa fica em 'stand by' por eleições
item.description: The dollar rose to R$5.22 and global interest rates surged, pressuring the Brazilian economy ahead of elections. The stock market remains stable around 185,000 points, while investors await the first round to define strategies.

item.title: Nova pesquisa Datafolha mostra como está disputa entre Tarcísio e Haddad em SP
item.description: A November Datafolha poll shows Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos) leading the gubernatorial race in São Paulo with 50%, compared to 35% for Fernando Haddad. Voter rejection is higher for Haddad (45%) than for Tarcísio (29%).

item.title: Datafolha: A quatro dias da eleição, Tarcísio lidera com 50%, contra 33% de Haddad
item.description: Tarcísio de Freitas leads voting intentions in São Paulo with 50%, against 33% for Fernando Haddad, according to a Datafolda poll released four days ahead of the election. The margin of error is two percentage points, with blank and invalid votes plus undecided reaching 10%.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro pede ao STF inquérito contra Lindbergh e Rogério Correia por denúncias contra ele
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro filed a criminal complaint against federal deputies Lindbergh Farias (PT-RJ) and Rogério Correia (PT-MG), accusing them of defamation. The petition was sent to Minister Luiz Fux at the Supreme Federal Court, requesting an investigation into 20 alleged misconducts by the parliamentarians.

item.title: AGU pede investigação de suposto financiamento dos EUA à agenda anti-STF no Brasil
item.description: The Brazilian Attorney General's Office requested an investigation into alleged U.S. funding of groups seeking to delegitimize the Supreme Federal Court, based on a Guardian report. The Trump administration reportedly allocated $1 million from a human rights fund to support far-right initiatives in Brazil. The case is considered especially serious amid the ongoing electoral period and recent foreign pressure on Brazilian institutions.

item.title: Datafolha: 47% avaliam a gestão Tarcísio como positiva e 21% como negativa em SP
item.description: Datafolha survey shows 47% of São Paulo residents rate Tarcísio de Freitas' administration positively, while 21% view it negatively. In the gubernatorial race, Tarcísio leads with 50% of voting intentions, followed by Fernando Haddad at 33%.

item.title: Datafolha em SP: Tarcísio, 50%; Haddad, 33%
item.description: A Datafolha poll released after the Globo debate shows Tarcísio de Freitas leading with 50% of votes and Fernando Haddad at 33% in the São Paulo gubernatorial race. Among valid votes, the gap widens to 56% for Tarcísio versus 37% for Haddad. In a potential runoff, Tarcísio leads 55% to 45% over Haddad.

item.title: Renan Santos convoca ato em frente à Globo após ficar fora de debate
item.description: Candidate Renan Santos (Missão) called on supporters to protest in front of TV Globo after being excluded from the presidential debate hosted by the network. The party sought judicial guarantees for participation at the TSE and STF, but requests were rejected for not meeting the minimum parliamentary representation required for mandatory debates.

item.title: Barrado em debate, Renan fará protesto na vizinhança da TV Globo
item.description: Renan Santos, candidate from Missão to the Presidency, will protest outside TV Globo after being barred from the debate. Minister Carmen Lucia and the TSE president rejected his requests to participate. The debate will feature Flavio Bolsonaro, Ronaldo Caiado, Augusto Cury, and Romeu Zema.

item.title: AGU pede que Polícia Federal descubra quem recebeu dinheiro de Trump para atacar o STF
item.description: The AGU requested the PF and PGR to investigate alleged Trump payments to Brazilian right-wing leaders to undermine the STF and democracy. A Guardian report revealed Trump funded a Countering Lawfare and Censorship program in Brazil, involving figures like President Lula and the Bolsonaro family.

item.title: A estratégia de Caiado para o debate da Globo
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) defined strategy for Globo debate focusing on self-presentation, highlighting experience as Goiás governor. The campaign assesses that attacks on opponents have low audience outside polarization, prioritizing connection with undecided voters.

item.title: Fachin nega pedido para afastar Dino de ações ligadas a Flávio e Lula nas eleições
item.description: The President of the Supreme Federal Court (STF), Edson Fachin, denied Flávio Bolsonaro's request to remove Minister Flávio Dino from cases related to the 2026 elections. Flávio's lawyers alleged Dino's partiality in matters such as parliamentary amendments, film funding, and political investigations. The decision was made in Suspection Appeal 259, without granting a preliminary injunction to suspend proceedings under Dino's rapporteurship.

item.title: Julgamento sobre 'Nossa Senhora' resolve impasse entre TSE e STF, mas tensão segue alta entre ministros das Cortes
item.description: The TSE ruling on the 'Nossa Senhora' case resolved the conflict between the Electoral Court and the STF, but tensions among judges remain high. The decision removed fake posts attributed to Flávio Bolsonaro, aligning closer to Flávio Dino's stance and limiting André Mendonça's original vote. Despite the resolution, ministers continue exchanging sharp words, with no signs of reconciliation before the first round.

item.title: Fachin rejeita pedido de Flávio Bolsonaro para afastar Dino de processos
item.description: STF president Edson Fachin rejected Flávio Bolsonaro's request to remove Minister Flávio Dino from cases involving President Lula. Flávio claimed Dino is biased due to alleged ties with the PT, though no direct interaction occurred between them in the cited instance.

item.title: Não tem novela hoje? 'Quem Ama Cuida' não terá exibição nesta quinta-feira pela Globo; saiba mais
item.description: The Globo network holds the final presidential debate before the first round of the 2026 elections on Thursday, October 1st, at 9:30 PM, featuring five candidates following Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva's (PT) confirmed absence. The network adjusts its programming to accommodate the debate, suspending the telenovela 'Quem Ama Cuida' and shortening other shows. Alongside Flávio Bolsonaro, Augusto Cury, Ronaldo Caiado, and Romeu Zema, this marks the first election without a direct confrontation between the leaders of the main political forces.

item.title: Não é 'teflon', há eleitor que aceita corrupção de Flávio para tirar Lula
item.description: The article argues it is incorrect to label politicians as 'teflon' when allegations do not hinder their viability. In Flávio Bolsonaro's case, the phenomenon reflects pragmatic cynicism among voters who tolerate corruption to remove Lula from the political scene.

item.title: Nunes Marques analisará novo pedido de Bolsonaro por revisão de condenação
item.description: Minister Kassio Nunes Marques of the STF was appointed as the rapporteur for a new criminal review request filed by the defense of former president Jair Bolsonaro. The case will be analyzed at the Supreme Federal Court.

item.title: Dino elogia decisão do TSE sobre Tabet: 'Afastou censura prévia e em massa'
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Flávio Dino acknowledged the TSE decision by dismissing prior and mass censorship to comedian Antonio Tabet's post about Our Lady of Aparecida. Tabet rejected the request for removal and reposted the original content.

item.title: De olho no eleitor do Sudeste, Lula e Flávio visitam mesmos estados na reta final da campanha
item.description: Lula and Bolsonaro focus on the Southeast region with simultaneous campaign events in São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, and Minas Gerais. Recent polls show Bolsonaro leading in SP and RJ, while MG remains tied within the margin of error. The region accounts for 40% of the national electorate, making it decisive for the first-round outcome.

item.title: Dino encerra ação no STF após TSE manter no ar post de Tabet sobre Nossa Senhora
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Flávio Dino closed the legal action against comedian Antonio Tabet after the TSE decided to keep a post about Our Lady of Aparecida online. The decision reinforces Dino's stance against prior restraint on religious freedom.

item.title: Teologia do domínio ganha força no Brasil com avanço político evangélico; entenda
item.description: The dominion theology, which advocates religious influence over politics, is gaining momentum in Brazil with the rise of evangelical candidates ahead of the 2026 elections. The debate over church-state relations intensifies on social media and messaging groups.

item.title: Maquiavel diz a Lula por que não ir à Globo: não se joga xadrez com pombos
item.description: President Lula decided not to participate in the debate promoted by Globo, considering it more of a media spectacle than a serious debate of ideas. The article criticizes the stance of the Extreme Right Front (FUEDEC) and defends institutional stability as a priority, avoiding polarization.

item.title: Dilma desembarca no Brasil para votar no 1º turno
item.description: Former President Dilma Rousseff returned to Brazil to vote in the first round of the 2026 elections on Sunday. Currently residing in Shanghai, China, where she leads the New Development Bank (NDB), she will cast her ballot in Belo Horizonte, where she maintains her electoral address.

item.title: Agenda Global: Na mineração, desafios a superar
item.description: The enactment of the National Policy for Critical and Strategic Minerals (PNMCE) marks a regulatory advance, yet requires investments, technology and public-private cooperation to turn regulatory predictability into concrete processing and refining projects. Experts highlight that future competitiveness favors countries able to mobilize public policy, capital and productivity, positioning Brazil as a potential strategic partner of the US and other global markets.

item.title: Crise com a CNBB expõe limites da aliança de Flávio Bolsonaro com católicos, aponta estudo
item.description: The clash between Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign and the CNBB highlights the erosion of his alliance with traditional Catholic sectors, worsened by the lack of support from key influencers who backed Jair Bolsonaro in 2022. The controversy over a false rumor involving Brazil's patron saint exposed vulnerabilities in the PL candidate's electoral base.

item.title: Projeções apontam avanço democrata nos EUA impulsionado por rejeição a Trump
item.description: Polls for the US midterms project a strong performance for the Democratic Party, driven by Donald Trump's low approval ratings. According to Carlos Odio, Trump's subversion of traditional political rules has shifted from a strength to a weakness, negatively affecting economic perception through tariffs and international tensions.

item.title: Aliados usaram pesquisas para tentar convencer Lula a ir ao debate da Globo
item.description: Lula's allies used qualitative polls to persuade him to attend the TV Globo debate, emphasizing the negative impact of his absence. The strategy aimed to reinforce his image and avoid electoral damage. The article is exclusive to subscribers.

item.title: Meio-Dia em Brasília: Renan é barrado de debate; TSE passa pano para fake news eleitoral
item.description: The Meio-Dia em Brasília program discusses expectations surrounding the Globo debate and Justice Carmen Lúcia's decision preventing Renan Santos from participating. The show also addresses the controversial TSE decision not to investigate an electoral fake news claim circulating online.

item.title: Homem do Maranhão usa nome de Bolsonaro para prestar serviço nas eleições
item.description: A 31-year-old man from Maranhao used Jair Bolsonaro's name in official TSE documents to provide electoral services to federal deputy candidate Francisco Mello. According to court records, the impostor donated $1 and received $500 for militancy and street mobilization activities. This situation is not specifically addressed in the Electoral Code but may be linked to document forgery.

item.title: Lula assina acordo e Santos mantém o CT Rei Pelé por 20 anos
item.description: President Lula signed a 20-year lease agreement granting Santos FC use of the Rei Pelé Training Center, with monthly payments of R$145,000, amid a nationwide ban on sports betting.

item.title: Empresário que buscou vacina russa contra Covid doa R$ 500 mil a Flávio
item.description: Fernando de Castro Marques, owner of União Química, donated R$500,000 to Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL) presidential campaign. The businessman gained prominence negotiating the Russian Sputnik V vaccine during the pandemic, when Jair Bolsonaro opposed its purchase and Anvisa did not approve it.

item.title: Renan Santos apela até ao STF para ir ao debate da ‘Globo’, mas fracassa
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Cármen Lúcia rejected an appeal by the Missão party for TV Globo to invite presidential candidate Renan Santos to a debate, deeming the action an attempt to bypass ordinary procedural measures. The TSE, led by Kassio Nunes Marques, also denied the request. The party argued that Renan's absence from the debate was intended to manipulate the election.

item.title: Candidato dos R$ 10 trilhões alega erro: "Era R$ 1 mil”
item.description: State deputy candidate Dr. Elcio (MDB) from Santa Catarina corrected a typo that had recorded a donation of R$10 trillion, adjusting it to R$1,000. The donation from Ismael Amândio was revised by the TSE after the candidate reported the discrepancy. With the correction, the campaign’s total funding reaches R$24,500.

item.title: Do fim da escala 6×1 ao fim da Justiça do Trabalho: o que defendem os presidenciáveis
item.description: As the 2026 election intensifies, presidential candidates are focusing on labor reform as a key strategy to win over more than 21 million undecided voters. Major proposals include ending the 6×1 work scale, reducing the workweek to 40 hours, protecting gig economy workers and fighting outsourcing. Lula leads these efforts with proposals aligned with ILO guidelines and traditional PT base positions.

item.title: Moraes aplica multa de R$ 5 mil a advogado de réu do 8/1 por uso de prompt oculto de IA para manipular sistema do STF
item.description: Supreme Federal Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes fined lawyer Marcelo Henrique Martins 5,000 BRL for using AI 'prompt injection' techniques to manipulate the court's system in a case related to the January 8th events. The practice was detected by a security module and considered an offense to judicial dignity. Despite the attempt, the non-prosecution agreement with defendant Rodrigo Tadeu Barbassa was upheld.

item.title: Nossa Senhora: Dino vê perda de objeto em ação sobre post de Tabet após TSE
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Flávio Dino declared the loss of subject matter in a lawsuit challenging a post by Antônio Tabet regarding Flávio Bolsonaro's alleged intention to remove Our Lady of Aparecida's title as Brazil's patron saint. The TSE upheld the post, citing ambiguity and prioritizing freedom of expression, while ordering the removal of other publications. The case raises controversy over the balance between religious freedom, electoral law, and freedom of speech.

item.title: Quem são todos os candidatos a governador do Amapá (AP) nas eleições 2026
item.description: In the 2026 elections, five politicians run for Amapá governor: Clécio Luís (União Brasil), seeking re-election, and Dr. Furlan (MDB), leading in polls. Other candidates include Carlos Cley (PSTU), Delegado Marcos (DC), and Jairo Palheta (PCO).

item.title: Renan Santos após ser barrado em debate: Brasil é um puteiro; país amaldiçoado
item.description: Renan Santos, presidential candidate from Missão, released a video making derogatory remarks about Brazil after being barred from a TV Globo debate by Minister Cármen Lúcia. He labeled the country a 'brothel' and 'cursed', sparking backlash over offensive rhetoric.

item.title: Ex-MasterChef, Jesuíno é criticado após post sobre vitória de Jéssica
item.description: Jesuíno Arcanjo, a former contestant of MasterChef Brasil 13, faced backlash after posting a message praising Jéssica Cechella's victory with phrases like 'When you have family and principles, everything works out!', sparking speculation about a veiled jab at Carla Araújo, the runner-up and openly lesbian. Leo Salles, winner of MasterChef Confeitaria 2025, also criticized the post, linking it to homophobic discourse. The incident reignited debates on social media about competition rivalries and respect for the LGBTQIA+ community.

item.title: Defesa de Bolsonaro pede ao STF anulação de condenação
item.description: Jair Bolsonaro's defense filed a new criminal review petition with the Supreme Federal Court seeking to annul his 27-year-and-3-month sentence for attempted coup after the 2022 elections. The motion, assigned to Justice Kassio Nunes Marques, challenges alleged chain-of-custody flaws in digital evidence and claims violations of due process rights. Lawyers also request a preliminary injunction to suspend the conviction's effects during review.

item.title: PRF, TREs e forças de segurança atuarão em conjunto nas eleições
item.description: The Brazilian Federal Highway Police (PRF) will work jointly with electoral courts and security forces to ensure voter safety and unimpeded access to polling stations during the 2026 elections. Measures include route planning, traffic restrictions for large vehicles, and exceptional roadblocks authorized by the Electoral Judiciary. Coordination will be managed by the National Integrated Command and Control Center, preventing controversial situations like those seen in 2022.

item.title: Lula silencia sobre supersalários e rivais citam cortes genéricos no funcionalismo em planos de governo
item.description: Lula remains silent on supersalaries while rivals cite generic public service cuts in government plans. The issue is central to proposals, but few candidates detail how to address it.

item.title: Após decisão do TSE, Antonio Tabet faz novo post sobre Nossa Senhora
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court (TSE) decided, by majority, to keep online a post by comedian Antonio Tabet that compares a 'militia family' to an attack on the image of Our Lady of Aparecida, after an initial veto by Minister André Mendonça. The decision balanced freedom of expression and protection of religious imagery, maintaining content that does not name-candidate Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) directly.

item.title: Candidatos a presidente em 2026: veja nome e o número de cada um
item.description: Brazil holds its 2026 presidential election with 13 candidates, including Lula (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), voting on October 4, with a possible runoff on October 25. The race brings together figures from various ideological spectrums, with different coalitions and running mates. The electoral landscape shows a diversity of profiles, from seasoned politicians to activists and professionals from other fields.

item.title: Porte de armas para CAC é proibido em todo país na véspera das eleições
item.description: The TSE prohibits collectors, shooters, and hunters (CACs) from carrying firearms and ammunition nationwide in the 24 hours before and after elections, establishing a minimum distance of 100 meters from polling stations for armed civilians. This measure, in effect since 2022 and renewed in 2026, aims to protect the vote, prevent conflicts, and ensure the integrity of the democratic process, exempting active-duty police. Non-compliance results in arrest for illegal weapon possession, without prejudice to electoral crimes.

item.title: Qual é o número de Marcos Dias para o Senado pelo Rio de Janeiro?
item.description: Councilor Marcos Dias (Podemos) is running for the Brazilian Senate in Rio de Janeiro under candidate number 200 in the October 4 election. Voters must enter the number and confirm their vote, selecting two different candidates for the Senate.

item.title: Qual é o número de Luciano Mattos para o Senado pelo Rio de Janeiro?
item.description: Attorney Luciano Mattos, running under the PRTB party, is one of 16 candidates vying for a Senate seat in Rio de Janeiro for the 2026 election. Voters must enter 280, his three-digit candidate number, and press the green confirmation button. Voting takes place in the first round on October 4th.

item.title: Deputado federal por São Paulo (SP): veja nome e número dos candidatos
item.description: The 2026 elections in São Paulo will include voting for 70 federal deputy seats, with over 34 million eligible voters. Voters must enter the candidate's four-digit number and confirm on the electronic ballot. The full list of candidates is available on GLOBO's website, including party, number, and TSE status.
